title: Python and Rust SCHC v3 registries and selection order diverge
description: Correctness review: Python includes rule IDs64-66 and excludes 255 while Rust includes 255 and omits 64-66; Python prioritizes OSCORE rules while Rust iterates 0..6, yielding different selected IDs. Define one canonical registry membership and deterministic selection order; assert identical IDs, descriptor hashes, get, and select results; clarify building-block wire status.
